小丸子一班去遠足和賞楓，小杉因不夠飽而四處覓食，聽老師說楓葉可做成天婦羅後深感興趣。嫲嫲走進河裡幫小孩撿皮球，回來後卻發現爺爺送她的手套不見了，嫲嫲不敢說出來，令爺爺胡思亂想。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
小朋友踢足球時，發現轉動中的足球會自動停下來而感好奇，科學科老師吳偉力，解釋原理與「摩擦力」有關。一支筷子如何將膠樽提起？哪些因素會影響摩擦力的大小？把分別載著水和沙的膠樽同時放在斜板上，哪個滾得較遠？吳老師透過多項實驗，讓大家了解摩擦力的「威力」。當鉛筆插入載滿水的膠袋中，為何水卻沒有溢出？日常生活還有甚麼是利用了摩擦力的原理？Master Joe還會解答魚兒在海中組成一排向前游的原因。
多啦A夢讓胖虎吃下靚聲糖，令他短時間內唱出優美歌聲，詎料讓電視台監製聽見，更邀請胖虎上電視唱歌。胖虎舉辦晚宴演唱會，大雄被迫負責賣票，眾人收到消息後爭相走避，最終只賣給出木杉一個。

小丸子一班去遠足和賞楓，小杉因不夠飽而四處覓食，聽老師說楓葉可做成天婦羅後深感興趣。嫲嫲走進河裡幫小孩撿皮球，回來後卻發現爺爺送她的手套不見了，嫲嫲不敢說出來，令爺爺胡思亂想。
《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。
小朋友踢足球時，發現轉動中的足球會自動停下來而感好奇，科學科老師吳偉力，解釋原理與「摩擦力」有關。一支筷子如何將膠樽提起？哪些因素會影響摩擦力的大小？把分別載著水和沙的膠樽同時放在斜板上，哪個滾得較遠？吳老師透過多項實驗，讓大家了解摩擦力的「威力」。當鉛筆插入載滿水的膠袋中，為何水卻沒有溢出？日常生活還有甚麼是利用了摩擦力的原理？Master Joe還會解答魚兒在海中組成一排向前游的原因。
多啦A夢讓胖虎吃下靚聲糖，令他短時間內唱出優美歌聲，詎料讓電視台監製聽見，更邀請胖虎上電視唱歌。胖虎舉辦晚宴演唱會，大雄被迫負責賣票，眾人收到消息後爭相走避，最終只賣給出木杉一個。

「廠長」蚌蚌公主開心迎來兩隊零食小兵團，大家亦準備好接受挑戰 ，力爭獲得廠長手中的零食秘笈。兩隊通過「廠長話」熱身賽熟習遊戲後都有出色表現，淘汰賽展開，四人接連做對了十多個指令，才出現首位出錯者。運送冬甩任務對小兵的手腳協調能力，要求不低，兩隊均有成員不小心掉落冬甩要從頭開始。臨近完賽一刻，更有小兵因心急而掉落冬甩，錯失首回合勝機。另外，「小手指工作室」環節，帶來「卡紙銀包」的DIY教學。
小丸子隨爸爸晚上巡區提高防火意識，事後到居酒屋小休，其間得以窺探成年人的世界。小玉不小心弄壞盛載其父母回憶的音樂盒，去鐘錶店找人修理但不果，小丸子提議她學習用鋼琴把曲子彈奏出來。

今集開始會以介紹「羽毛球」為主題。主持連同香港羽毛球總會教練廖國華會為大家介紹羽毛球運動。廖老師先來教授羽毛球技巧和知識，包括正手、反手握球拍，以及正手、反手開球的方法。原來羽毛球拍的線最初是用羊腸製造；另外，怎樣分辨羽毛球的優劣？上佳的羽毛球用的是甚麼羽毛？主持前往了解有關羽毛球拍穿線及羽毛球的羽毛類別，以擴闊小朋友的學習視野，引起他們的學習興趣。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。

未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
未來世界，灰心星球的大大怪和小小怪攜帶具有強大力量的五顆機械石侵略星星球，其中四顆和宇宙中流浪的四輛廢舊機車意外結合，在宅博士的幫助下變成了開心超人、甜心超人、粗心超人和花心超人。
生活在孤兒院的13歲少女茱蒂亞伯特，被「長腿叔叔」選中全額補助讓茱蒂進入林肯紀念女子學院。「長腿叔叔」要求茱蒂每個月要寫一封答謝信，報告自己的近況給他知道。而茱蒂亦開始了她所憧憬的高中生活。
翁丁尼宣佈由觀眾投票決定大匯演時誰站C位，並呼籲一眾拍檔應該做好自己本分。琪沐沐認為希娜經已完美，失敗幾次後，失去當希娜拍檔的信心，於是向希娜請辭。希娜要求她留下看其單獨表演的星光魔法。

趙三郎帶羅黛的靈柩回江南，豈遇東海龍王借舟，發現相貌酷似黛的香螺郡主，郎向螺道出與黛的愛情故事。螺感動，決借黛屍首化身成黛，與郎成婚。黛還陽，赫然發現軀體已被螺附上，幸得觀音相助，一對有情人再續前緣。
名伶潘子安因送愛女潘慧賢回學校而失場，妻子林玉鳳好言相勸，反被趕走。安因大老倌脾氣變得潦倒，為使賢能夠上學，生活安檼，安忍痛趕她到鳳身邊，然後離去。賢、鳳急往尋安，鳳勸安放下自大自卑，最終一家團聚。

epg.programme_title_en: Save the Mother from Huang Shing
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魯國王子臨終前託司馬英將國書代為傳送。英冒認魯國王子打敗凌霄將軍迎娶晉國玉霞公主，惜其後被揭發遭放逐。霄與晉妃奪位，幸霞與兒子小龍脫險。龍長大後與英重聚，霞卻被擄走，英與龍去魯國求援，晉室正統終光復。
唐三藏往天竺取西經，先後收孫悟空、沙悟淨、豬八戒為徒。四人路上遇到不少妖怪，悟空多番開殺戒，被三藏趕走。牛魔王擄走三藏，八戒和悟淨向悟空求助，悟空把三藏救出，還騙得芭蕉扇弄熄火焰山的火，四人繼續上路。

epg.programme_title_en: Rich Gentleman and the Fierce, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孔文禮邂逅周玉萍，兩人迅速發展起來。孔、周兩家為婚事起風波，幸得禮好友高廣良獻計，禮、萍才順利完婚。婚後，孔家以為禮夫綱大振，周家則以為萍御夫有道，豈料一次意外，二人把戲被識破，兩家人鬧得不可開交……
李國英遇梁玉梅被張彪欺凌，奮勇相救，兩人情愫互生。英與梅成婚，彪從中挑撥，令李母對梅不滿將她趕走。英患重病，梅賣唱賺錢，英卻誤會梅貪圖富貴，傷心回家。英的舅父揭穿彪的詭計，英知錯怪梅，李母亦與梅冰釋。
黑璇風行俠仗義救人，巧遇打抱不平的一丈紅父女，三人合力救出民女。紅父女賣藝，藍九少看上紅，挾持其父逼她下嫁，紅施計拖延。九少強搶金玉蘭，紅暗中助黑璇風救出蘭，九少追至，紅報官讓九少伏法，成功救出父親。

凌青雲出征，與妻王寶珊分離。西妃謀害東宮，太子輾轉被珊收養，改名凌泰隆。其後飢荒連年，珊割肉餵兒將隆養大。雲歸來誤會珊對其不忠，隆亦怪珊不貞，幸終誤會冰釋。平西王助隆回宮除奸登位，珊苦盡甘來與雲團聚。
（續上集）唐三藏四人於取經路上屢遇妖精，幸一一化險為夷。來到車遲國，孫悟空遇上虎力大仙等妖道，將他們打敗，誰料狙力大仙假扮悟空，離間他與三藏的感情，更將三藏捉去。悟空得觀音幫助救出三藏，師徒冰釋前嫌。
何業生與張玉琴、楊文樂與顏素莊、胡經牧與沈慕潔，三對夫婦為生活，所做的工作卻並不是自己的專長，弄致笑料百出，誤會重重。其後樂、莊、琴及牧先後因無心工作犯錯而被辭退，幸各人誤打誤撞終得償所願，各展所長。
區文立一家因三叔欠債逃去而變得一貧如洗，其後立父雙目失明，立又因病而遭公司辭退，更禍不單行，鄰居失火令一家人無處容身。立妻為籌錢險些被逼賣淫，幸被鄰居陳康所救。最終三叔回來清還債項，區家終可度過難關。

甘慧生因天生三眼遭父遺棄，長大後隨莊玉英學藝。生邂逅少女溫明珠，後珠遭尤霸天擄去，生誤會是甘卓雄所為，於是英與甘妻程秋雲激戰，雲被打傷。雲偶然救出珠，並得知一切真相。英偕生往救雲後，生喜與雄、雲相認。
何業生與張玉琴、楊文樂與顏素莊、胡經牧與沈慕潔，三對夫婦為生活，所做的工作卻並不是自己的專長，弄致笑料百出，誤會重重。其後樂、莊、琴及牧先後因無心工作犯錯而被辭退，幸各人誤打誤撞終得償所願，各展所長。
婢女白秋雲懷了少爺周文光的骨肉，惜被拆散鴛鴦，光更誤會雲負情，與表妹成親。雲誕下兒子周寶寶，數年後，雲因貧窮將寶抵押於周家。寶與雲先後被誣陷殺人，最後寶施計令真相水落石出，光與雲前嫌盡釋，一家團聚。

epg.programme_title_en: Red Child Saves His Mother, The
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 牛魔王、鐵扇公主因犯天條而被貶下凡間。多年後火燄山爆發，龍王取得舍利子後，再施美人計騙取芭蕉扇以抗熱，牛受誘中計。鐵往龍宮尋夫慘遭囚禁，幸獲紅孩兒所救。時孫悟空為尋舍利子而至，龍王終歸還寶物平息風波。
崔琼珍遵從父母遺訓照顧弟妹，專注工作。其弟妹擔心珍嫁杏無期，介紹趙福根給珍認識。珍與根一見傾慕，共墮愛河。珍暗中助根發展事業，根得悉後忿而辭職，惟根不忍珍傷心，兩人和好。各人也覓得如花美眷，皆大歡喜。
陳德昌常因應酬冷落賢妻李氏，更納二姑娘為妾。二姑娘與廖畢誠有染，兩人使計令昌趕走李氏，又買兇殺其子小志，幸得老僕秋伯相救。多年後，昌得知二姑娘惡行，在誠與二姑娘挾帶私逃時報警將其拘捕，與志及李氏團聚。
獨臂神尼臨終前囑咐弟子呂四娘完成其遺志。反清首領沈在寬被了恩囚於天牢，四娘與天山弟子唐曉瀾及馮瑛趕往相救。他們於宮中遇到琳貴人，原來她是瑛自小失散的妹，在琳的幫忙下救出寬，並手刃了恩，完成神尼的遺願。

李尚書把女兒秀英許配王玉林，林卻於成親當日受騙，誤會英與其表兄有私情。林婚後冷待英，後得悉錯怪嬌妻，向英求諒，不果。林高中狀元，卻因拒為駙馬被囚。英藉此機會試出林真心，與之和好，而得英父求情，林獲釋。
江德信與巫日明、周麒麟、阮地龍於龍雙田的公司工作，田對新聘請的女秘書多多生子意圖不軌，信等人多番壞其好事。田誘騙多往酒店，信等四人趕往阻止，卻讓信妻許雪心誤會，以為信不忠，幸多誘田道出一切，二人冰釋。
（續上集）雍正派兵剿滅反清義士。四娘等人欲刺殺雍正，馮瑛被擒，幸得唐曉瀾相救，瀾卻誤喝毒酒。沈在寬被殺，四娘悲痛。瀾毒發，寬突出現，原來清兵所殺是其堂弟。其實瀾並無中毒，痊癒後與四娘等人成功手刃雍正。
唐振英、唐振傑乃同父異母兄弟，傑與表妹楊淑薇一見鍾情。傑誤交損友，沉迷賭博，欠下千元賭債。英私自拿公款幫傑還債，並代其認罪，姨丈將英逐出藥材店。數年後，英攜眷參加姨丈壽筵，卻遭白眼，傑不忍終說出真相。

趙京娘之父經商於外，後母朱氏與表兄黃瑞有染，被京娘發現。京娘為逃避二人迫害，上京尋父，惜途中遇響馬，被囚於道觀中。趙匡胤因事藏身道觀，聞京娘哭聲，救出京娘。匡胤為免招人口舌，與其結為義兄妹護送京娘回家。京娘對匡胤生情，但匡胤不欲蒙上不義之名拒愛。匡胤把京娘送抵家中，京娘未敢揭穿朱氏姦情。京父欲將京娘許配予匡胤，朱氏及黃瑞卻出言不遜，將之氣走。黃瑞恐醜事被揭，勒殺京娘；匡胤遇京娘鬼魂，助她報仇雪恨。

尤秀鳳遇上流浪劍客凌劍青，適尤氏鏢局被人搗亂，青拔刀相助。鳳的大師兄郭大豪見鳳、青投契，擔心自己地位不保，故請過江龍除掉青，霸佔鏢局，但龍得手後不肯歸還鏢局。豪悔不當初，終與青、鳳合力肅清龍及其黨羽。
李大偉與羅翠玲將新屋的一個房間租予楊志華。一次，玲代華修補褲子，偉看見感不悅。其後偉更誤會兩人有姦情，決意離婚，成全二人。當偉得知真相，欲阻止玲與華成婚，於結婚當日，偉發現新娘是華的女友，才知被戲弄。

However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the Seven Deadly Sins to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely Ah Zhen is bullied by his coworkers. When he spends his birthday with Yumi, his friends shockingly discover that Yumi is an inflatable doll. Seeking companionship, Ah Zhen turns to the internet and finds his ideal girl Mina. Her arrival transforms his life but a series of unexpected events unfold as her identity as a vampire is revealed.

One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yis ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xues buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 被譽為“屍語者的法醫秦明常可在屍體身上解剖出重要的線索。在調查一宗謀殺案時,秦明在實習助手和刑警隊長的協助下發現了塵封16年的雪山殺人案,同時亦揭發離奇謀殺案背後隱藏著的秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次車禍後失憶的王人傑找到夜間警衛的工作。午夜,他準時抵達廢棄的大廈上班,卻發現三隻冤魂如約而至,並揭發了一場復仇計畫。究竟這是命運的安排還是邪靈的詛咒?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jas正與妹妹Laura享受著鄉郊的平靜假期,這份寧靜卻被一群突然出現的流浪漢徹底打破。Laura慘遭殺害後,Jas回到租來的小屋,發現妹妹冰冷的屍體。在悲慟與狂怒之中,她誓言追獵這群兇徒到底,定要其..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jass peaceful countryside getaway with her sister Laura is shattered when a group of drifters attacks them. After Laura is brutally killed, Jas discovers her lifeless body at their rented cabin. Consumed by grief and fury, she vows to hunt down the gang and take vengeance on her sisters murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天凌晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鍾馗收伏狐妖後回到河陽村,卻發現戀人芊芊與鄉親慘遭屠殺。為追查真兇,他下山前往陵都城尋找線索,途中邂逅因妖魔所害而化為半人半妖的琉璃公主。鍾馗揮舞降魔劍斬妖除魔,誓要拯救琉璃公主並守護城池安寧。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hunting fox demons, Zhong Kui returns to Heyang Village only to discover that his lover and neighbours have been slaughtered. Following the trail to Lingdu City, he encounters Princess Liu Li, who has been cursed into a half-human, half-monster form. Armed with his demon-slaying sword, he battles the demons to save Liu Li and protect the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 書生王懷卿賣畫,為要籌藥費救患重病的妻子,途中意外遇上雀妖的追擊,幸得狐妖小容相救。為躲避雀妖,王懷卿將小容帶回家中,三人隨即陷入一場情感困局,而一段淒美的人妖虐戀亦隨即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 家豪和朋友在別墅裡舉辦生日派對,卻意外地連接上了恐怖的虛擬實境遊戲《七夜》。原本歡樂的慶祝活動瞬間變成了一場令人恐懼的經歷。為了生存,他們必須在遊戲中點燃蠟燭,並小心避開遊蕩的鬼魂。隨著他的兩位朋友相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer must write a hit novel to save his career. He retreats to his childhood home where his father, also a successful writer, died mysteriously. Upon discovering his fathers final manuscript, he realizes its far superior to anything he could create. He decides to plagiarize the work, setting off a series of horrifying events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。凌晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 羅雪與男友吵架後,出走來到深山民宿與伊伊成為合租室友。一晚,羅雪無意中撞破依依及其友人雷松殺死依依的前男友。為免走漏消息,他們囚禁羅雪於閣樓中。羅雪的知己蘇文發現她失蹤後,到處找尋她的下落。最後,羅雪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote BB accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yis ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xues buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

epg.programme_title_tc: Hide  Seek (aka The Last Hide  Seek)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Mins photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島進行直播旅行,途中遇上一位神秘老婦人,落入她精心設下的陷阱,被騙至一座偏遠孤島,成為她為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的目標。隨著被困的境況日益危急,她們必須拼命設法逃離。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs set out to live‑stream their trip to a remote island, but are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them there, intent on finding brides for her disabled grandsons. As they are captured, they must race against time to escape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女模特余虹敏入住了一間公寓式醫院,不久後在深夜離奇墜樓身亡。坊間開始流傳該醫院是「幽靈醫院」。事後,余虹敏的攝影師在深夜頻頻接到詭異電話,撰稿人在一場離奇車禍後神志不清,而她的好友則神秘失蹤…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島進行直播旅行,途中遇上一位神秘老婦人,落入她精心設下的陷阱,被騙至一座偏遠孤島,成為她為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的目標。隨著被困的境況日益危急,她們必須拼命設法逃離。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs set out to live‑stream their trip to a remote island, but are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them there, intent on finding brides for her disabled grandsons. As they are captured, they must race against time to escape.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being knocked out in a championship match, a Muay Thai fighter awakens in a surreal dreamscape born of her buried fears. Guided by a mysterious young man, she must battle inner demons through Korat-style Muay Thai. Her fight through illusions becomes a journey of self-discovery, confronting the darkness within to reclaim her true identity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 7 friends go on a road trip to a remote bungalow run by a village head and his daughter Suri. They host a party and ask Suri to help. Things spiral out of control and Suri is raped. Before killing herself, she curses them to be haunted in their dreams. As the friends are killed off one by one, they must break the curse to escape their deadly fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

The kid will join forces with Bello in a crazy attempt to get the book, and know as soon as possible how the story ends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... monsters!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is bored because Goomo is unable to learn new games, so he makes Mina turn him into a smarter Goomo. The problem is that nowGoomo is the one who gets bored playing the games that Bello wants to play.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her smile.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An accident with a toothbrush causes Princess to lose her smile. Rita will feel so sad that shell promise not to brush her teeth ever again. Her friends will do their best to prevent this from happening and, incidentally, make princess recover her smile.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The kids find it really fun to show their skills in gardening and to take care of a very special plant. Unfortunately, to take good care of somethingyou need to be persevering, a very difficult thing for Bello.

After developing some ideas theyll find out that that object is a lot closer than they have ever imagined.

Only by working together and being creative will they be able to turn a critical situation into a fun camping experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Being the last one to be picked for a team is always hard. But if youconsider yourself as the best player and its you own best friend who doesnt pick you, then its even harder.This is what happens to Bello, and he is not going to take it very well.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Queen shows the kids one of her favourite toys as a child: A trampoline! They all deduce to take turns to use it, but Rita doesnt want to come down and doesnt let anyone else play, so the others decide to force her to come down. But her endless energy will put her friends to the test.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Its a dark and rainy afternoon in Jammbo. The kids are sad because they cant go out, so the King proposes a fun activity: Telling a story taking turns. All toghether, theyll create a story that will surprise them and even transform them into ... monsters!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello is very surprised when he hears the King saying that its better to give gifts than to receive them. How can that be possible? Bello will do his best to prove that theory. Unfortunately his attempts will not turn out right for Goomo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Who says you cant do two things at the same time? Bello will try to prove that such a thing is possible and will try to take care of the King while celebrating a birthday. Will he succeed?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sidekick-Man realizes that to Jammbo-Man he is nothing but a petty assistant. That will makeSidekick-Man reconsider his loyalties and adopt a new and terrible personality. He will become ... the archenemy! Will he defeat Jammbo-Man?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Bello and Goomo in their super-hero guises Jammboman and Sidekickman create imaginary adventures that bring them face to face with Mina and Ongo who also wish to play super-heroes. It all becomes moot when the four super-hero wannabees are called into a real adventure: saving Rita who is stranded on a ledge over Jammbo Gorge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「多咀街」是一條丁字形的熱鬧街道,住客大多是各行各業的小市民。他們對社會所發生的大小事情喜歡談論,七嘴八舌,招惹是非;三言兩語,道出人情冷暖,有道是:言為心聲。不管是粵劇藝員、暴發戶、黑社會人物或司機,他們說的話是嬉笑怒罵或冷嘲熱諷也好,都足以反映出現實社會人情百態之一斑。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. Howeve

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自著名武俠小說家黃鷹之同名小說。故事講述,丁鵬與蕭立本是同門師兄弟,而丁妻與蕭妻則是兩姊妹。兩家本極為友好,後來丁妻誕下一子,而蕭妻誕下一女,但蕭獨喜子。丁妻為了成全姐夫心願,便來一個男女對換,惟完成此事後便告死去。蕭妻內心有愧,手抱兒子往見丁,不料為蕭暗中看見,頓生綠帽疑雲,狠然佈下瘋子殺
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiancé. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是根據《聊齋》中之《書癡》改編,故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺負,搬進常鬧鬼的「孝廉府」。然後玉柱遇上了顏如玉,二人及後結成夫婦。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉,將其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉,如玉化成厲鬼,將中元、良金等人殺害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世,不禁一陣辛酸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 續集中阿牛不幸的遭遇更令人心痛,當中不少更是笑中有淚的經歷。阿牛出獄後,再遇愛人阿花,可惜她已嫁為人妻;另一方面,戇直的阿牛仍不斷被狡猾的周大叔欺騙...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大理國王子段譽不懂武功,卻私自離宮闖蕩江湖。途中,段譽先後遇上玩蛇姑娘鍾靈和同父異母的姊姊木婉清。因緣際會下,段譽吸光朱蝮蟒的血和吃下碧血蛤,得到了絕世功力,最終更擊敗父親的多年仇敵黃袍人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobra’s bl

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼太監桂德海追殺世子朱锦,朱锦得青竹叟相救才倖免於難。桂當年與啞巴月仙誕下一女燕燕,桂竟利用父女之情,假借燕燕之手殺朱锦...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dup

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang and Jin’s daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he d

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖回到中原時,遇上黃蓉,二人一見鍾情雙雙墮入愛河。豈料,同時間歐陽克竟又向黃蓉提親。於是黃藥師決定以比武選婿,對決的勝方可娶女兒黃蓉為妻。經過一輪激戰,郭靖最後成功打敗歐陽克,奪得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang’s father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally bea

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓,生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星,從此飛黃騰達,但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao’s fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鄉村少女阿嬌、流浪漢大傻、收山老倌二叔公三人同住危樓,生活清苦但互相扶持。其後阿嬌被捧爲歌星,從此飛黃騰達,但她却漸漸發覺自己失去了最重要的東西...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao’s fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自古龍原著小說,講述「天下第一快刀」傅紅雪為報父仇,萬里尋凶;期間墮入七名兇手布下之圈套,處境岌岌可危...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she’s soon framed for her husband’s murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東大良富家子斗官學得一身功夫,在鄉間常闖禍;其母希望斗官娶妻立品,乃遣其上京參加香格格招親大會。其實斗官所以答允上京,目的是找名傳京城的三名北少爺-「千術北少爺」車載、泡妞高手「真厲害」和「神偷北少爺」時三手一較高下。四人不打不相識,最後更成為好友,合力對付仇家三眼道人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific int

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續。七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家,奉命征討宦官專權。展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh’s epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片,描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫,不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常,不久日軍全面侵入中國,亦正式展開殘酷的統治…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖與黃蓉將結拜兄弟楊康之子撫養成人,並取名楊過。黃蓉恐其學武後,替父報仇,為免養虎為患,不許楊過習武。負氣出走的楊過偶遇走火入魔的歐陽鋒,獲授蛤蟆功,更無意中獲悉自己的身世……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father’s death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and enc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 百毒派銳意製造武林不和,以實現稱霸江湖的野心。他們派出蒙面刺客殺戮另一門派,但其中一名刺客被捕後即被其他門派公審。最後審訊結果是什麼?最終又能否揭開真相?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they u

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1973年,香港股市暴漲人人熱衷炒賣股票,小市民因急於入住廉租屋而被不法之徒騙取金錢,及教育制度不健全引起民怨等均被改編成電影中的情節。故事諷刺寫實,反映了香港當時的真實面貌!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導,為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述,呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒, 由越南逃至澳門;呂於香港出生,可在港居留,乃與李分散;鄭則仕飾呂之叔父,為一幹練警探,即介紹呂加入員警世界,派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害;而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年廣州西關的陳家大屋,家道中落只剩下陳秀英及其入贅之丈夫楊振宇。秀英多病,而振宇又鬱鬱不得志,故常遭振宇辱打。直至自稱陳家僕人之女梁綺華的出現,聯同秀英反抗,竟錯手將振宇殺死!秀英自始活在驚恐之中,最終被振宇的鬼魂嚇死!原來這只是振宇在與綺華合谋殺害秀英,就在振宇以為可與綺華共築愛巢之際,秀英
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠,均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染,孟藉此勒索二人;後孟被殺,高成嫌疑犯,另孟之兄翟諾,亦向高勒索;而淩在家,也接見了穀峰,他聲言有為高洗罪的證據,但要索錢;王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin’s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司,其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端,圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈,化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困,自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock n roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to mar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men’s life essence. With a Taoist’s help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一天,絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走,徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中,阿檬遇上雖貪財,卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下,朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍,但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述一群年青人在愛情和情感相互交錯下,組成多個錯綜複雜的多角戀情。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後,悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮,新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標,不料,未等雷下手,另一殺手已捷足先登,倒在地上卻是另一要人,雷頓時成了替罪羊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家小姐梅淑卿與窮教師江少文,為了自由戀愛,脫離父母,從城市遷往小鎮結婚生活。他們生育五個兒女,但生存的擔子日重,二人長期辛勞,終相繼亡故。小兒女頓失庇蔭,直接面對複雜的社會,幾乎各散東西……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黑道幫主康聯興覬覦武林盟主地位,竟以東瀛武士挑戰武林總盟盟主袁增;一場酣戰,東瀛武士落敗,切腹自殺,死前留下遺書囑康聯興聘請忍者之王劍淵為其復仇。劍淵率領大批忍者前來中土,擺下「五遁陣」,向袁增挑戰。袁增派遣門下八位高手前去破陣,卻因對忍術一無所知,全部被殺。劍淵取得勝利後意猶未足,派出女忍者純子混
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty’s Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 基努李維主演《47浪人》,這是一部史詩奇幻電影,講述一名被放逐的浪人加入武士行列,為了對抗殘暴的領主、尋求復仇與榮耀,在古代日本展開驚心動魄的旅程。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.programme_title_en: The Man With The Iron Fists
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由RZA編劇、執導並主演,這部融合嘻哈風格的功夫動作片,以香港為背景,打破類型界限。由羅素・克洛、劉玉玲主演,並由昆汀・塔倫提諾監製。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: RZA co-writes, directs, and stars in this genre-blending, hip-hop-infused kung fu film set in Hong Kong, featuring Russell Crowe, Lucy Liu, and produced by Quentin Tarantino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《水世界》中,凱文・科斯納飾演被洪水淹沒的未來地球上一名獨行俠,保護一對母女免受殘暴遊牧族的追殺。丹尼斯・霍珀塑造出令人難忘的反派角色,為這部刺激冒險片增添亮點。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Waterworld*, Kevin Costner stars as a lone maverick in a flooded future Earth, protecting a mother and daughter from a tribe of ruthless nomads. Dennis Hopper delivers a memorable villainous performance in this thrilling adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《恐怖角》中,勞勃・狄尼洛飾演一名心懷怨恨的前科犯,對其昔日律師(尼克・諾特飾)展開步步進逼的跟蹤報復。由馬丁・史柯西斯執導,這部充滿張力的驚悚片是令人不寒而慄的經典重拍之作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Cape Fear, Robert De Niro plays a vengeful ex-con stalking his former lawyer, played by Nick Nolte. Directed by Martin Scorsese, this suspense-filled thriller is a chilling classic remake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 貪腐富豪殺害犯罪目擊者,唯一證人是一名與中國政府有關係的商人之女友。北京保鑣協助香港警方保護她,卻在過程中與證人產生情愫,令任務更加複雜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Corrupt tycoon kills witness to a crime. Only the girlfriend of a businessman with Chinese govt. ties saw it. Beijing bodyguard helps Hong Kong police protect her. But he and the witness develop feelings, complicating matters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 殺手與一名前陸軍特工,被捲入一名冷酷百萬富翁每年舉辦的荒島人獵遊戲,展開無情的生死追逐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Killers and an ex-Army agent take part in a ruthless millionaire’s annual island manhunt.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹是一名掙扎求生的牧場主,他自願押送被捕的盜賊首領班・韋德前往火車站,準備搭乘開往猶馬的 3:10列車接受審判。然而,班那群冷血無情的同夥卻早已盤算好其他計劃。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dan is a struggling rancher who volunteers to safely deliver Ben Wade, the captured leader of a gang of thieves, to a train station where the 3:10 to Yuma will transport him to trial. Ben’s gang of cutthroats and robbers has other plans.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧斯卡金像獎®提名者西爾維斯特史泰龍主演的這部動作驚悚片,將帶您體驗腎上腺素飆升的快感,直到最後一格震撼人心的畫面!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Academy Award®-Nominee Sylvester Stallone stars in this explosive action-thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the final, powerful frame!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two brothers try to fulfill the promise they made to their dying father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jackie Chan plays a dual role as twins separated at birth who grow up and cross paths. Two brothers, one becomes a famous conductor and pianist in New York, another becomes a racecar driver and bodyguard in Hong Kong. When the conductor travels to Hong Kong to give a concert, the twins get caught up in each other's business, about which they are anything but experts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: After a stagecoach is robbed and the passengers murdered, a long and tangled series of surprise attacks a murderous double-crosses leaves the coach’s strongbox in the hands of the killer Lasky. It is up to the legendary hero Sartana to track down the missing money and determine just who is ultimately behind the grisly robberies and killings.

However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 車王李一飛不甘於過氣的事實,為了爭一口氣證明自己,不料導致同隊女車手呂莉莉發生意外,他所屬的車隊因此陷入倒閉危機。直至一名毫無賽道經驗的虛擬賽車冠軍選手加入車隊後,其真實賽車表現竟超出預料。三人能否一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義父慘遭紅花會叛徒殺害,方世玉立誓要追兇復仇。悲痛與忠義驅使下,他毅然挺身對抗陰謀叛黨,掀起一場冷酷無情的正義之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與兩位泰國藝人Gun和Ticha一起展開旅程,探索香港繁華的城市生活和幽靜的郊區。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Embark on the journey with two Thai artistes, Gun and Ticha, as they navigate the bustling city life and discover the serene outskirts of Hong Kong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Ball是個韓國體育運動真人秀。節目邀請了韓國Iron Squad的特種部隊迎接一項新挑戰 — 閃避球。26名隊員將展開激烈角逐,直至選出一隊具超凡運動體能和最強心理素質的隊伍。在明星運動員..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 生命之樹被燒毀後,世間陷入一片混沌。為拯救蒼生,孫悟空決定回到過去,幫助生命之樹復活。因為失去了金箍棒,孫悟空力量時有時無,只得找回兒時的自己,一同前往尋找時間之力。不料,六耳獼猴卻想據為己有,兩人就..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曾是東北街頭武霸的阿能為了出人頭地,洗心革面來到香港的九龍城寨從零開始打拼,不料卻捲入一場黑惡勢力間的陰謀和混戰。最終為保護被黑惡勢力追殺的好朋友,阿能重拾自我,挺身而出,與城寨居民一同對抗黑惡勢力,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Ball是個韓國體育運動真人秀。節目邀請了韓國Iron Squad的特種部隊迎接一項新挑戰 — 閃避球。26名隊員將展開激烈角逐,直至選出一隊具超凡運動體能和最強心理素質的隊伍。在明星運動員..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 真人秀節目The Ultimate BROcation,跟隨四位不同國家的藝人玩轉男人遊樂之旅 - 香港,盡情狂歡並展開瘋狂野性的冒險,為觀眾們帶來充滿男性狂野魅力的視聽享受!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武松因發現他的嫂子潘金蓮與富家子弟西門慶有染,而被西門慶設計將他流放一年,在此期間,他的哥哥武大郎不幸被殺並火化下葬。武松回家後,告上公堂,誰知縣令三言兩語打回狀子,潦草結案。武松最終能否為哥哥報仇?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law’s affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother’s death?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們與馬來西亞的得獎女演員Siti Saleha 及其丈夫一起探索香港的白天与黑夜,感受這座城市充滿活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join award-winning Malaysian actress Siti Saleha and her husband as they explore the city by day and venture into the night, discovering its vibrant culture and hidden treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳真在日本流學時,發現多名中國學生失蹤,意外揭發黑龍會的陰謀。原來,黑龍會研發新藥以增強日本軍在戰爭中的體能,並捉拿中國學生做實驗。於是,陳真誓要瓦解黑龍會,並將其實驗密室搗毀。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society’s conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤練君在押解過程中逃脫,張道長亦因此被逐出師門。為追查赤煉君的下落,張道長來到一個地方,發現有很多平民無故失蹤。當張道長查出赤練君為練成蛇魔而抓走平民後,一場人魔大戰旋即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.programme_title_tc: R U Tough Enough: Toughness Redefined
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The growing regional competition R U Tough Enough is searching for the toughest person from Southeast Asia. Join the search and meet some of the most mentally and physically strong individuals, leading up to an epic final showdown in Kuala Lumpur for the prize of US$15,000!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 千年前,青蛇在道清的點化下逐漸開化,生出與道清相守之心。因自己對道清的執念,卻導致道清進入輪迴之劫,遭受世間橫死之難。為了化解道清的劫難,數百年間,青蛇不斷尋找轉世的道清…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Asias biggest human trafficker Ba Song, invites the triad bosses to attend his private party. Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盛世大唐氣象萬千,各色人物皆在江湖中行走,身懷絕技的盲眼“捉刀人成瞎子,遇上慘遭滅門和淩辱的酒家女倪燕。原本不與人有過多交情的成瞎子卻意外與她產生關聯,亦逐漸被捲入一場勢力龐大的暗黑紛爭中。成瞎子開..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talents are found everywhere in the Tang dynasty, including Blind man Cheng. He meets a barmaid Ni Yan, who has lost her family and gotten abused, and they become friends. This entangles Cheng into a big triad conflict, and as he starts his journey of revenge, his true identity is also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰,在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子,離開了兒女,潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終,華為了所有中國人要與無敵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jin Ao battles with Wu Di to preserve the Pride martial arts skill, which he passes to Hero Hua before he dies. Hua, who is born under the curse of the Star of Loneliness, leaves his family to practise the martial arts skill for 20 years, but still fails to master it. Can Hua finally master the skill and defeats Wu Di to save his people?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 霍元甲年少氣盛,認為武術為重。為了在天津的武館立足,他連續打敗了七家武館,在對戰大刀王五的徒弟幽蘭時,卻遭到朝廷勢力袁庭山的陷害。與此同時,霍負責護送維新首領譚先生回京城。在這次驚心動魄的任務中,他逐..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Huo Yuan Jia loves marital arts. He defeats seven martial arts school masters to establish himself in Tianjin, but is set up by a court official during a tournament. When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐朝末年,崑崙山昆吾閣長老的皇甫察覺到妖族破壞龍脈,便帶領弟子們前去與千年樹妖鬥法。樹妖吸收了魔物萬魄玄陰珠後實力大增,在激鬥中眾人損傷殆盡。此時皇耗盡法力啟動飛流法陣,將大弟子尋荼與女弟子楚靈兒送回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kun Lun Master Huang and his disciples fight against the Thousand Year Tree Demon who seeks to eliminate the Emperors heir. The demon becomes powerful after taking in a sorcerous pill, causing deaths and injuries. Huang then uses his power to send his disciples back in time, hoping that the demon can be conquered before the pill was taken.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發,感染者失去理智,瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店,前往安全地方,在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突,互相猜忌。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gou and his friends encounter a food virus outbreak at the hotel, which causes infected people to bite others insanely. Gou tries to bring his friends out from the hotel but this results in a fierce battle with those being infected. As conflicts and suspicions arise during the escape, can they finally reconcile and flee successfully?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 墨家機關術嫡系傳人沈拓接受無極監獄典獄長的邀請,與六名隊友進入機關城最底部,尋找墨家磁石,打開監獄機關。但墨家機關在城內佈局千變萬化,傳言至今從未有人能夠活著出來。沈拓為了救出妻子姜刃,及讓監獄里的人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shen Tuo, a descendant of Mohist Mechanism, is invited by the prison chief to find a magnet in the prison basement with a team of six. However, there is a rumour that no one can leave the basement alive. Determined to save his wife and free the prisoners, Shen embarks on a dangerous journey through the citys labyrinth of mechanism.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 屠浮宮是東廠專門結交黨羽的朝庭禁地。大太監劉瑾為了得到大明藏寶圖,想借鑒賞寶物大會之名除掉與他不和的錦衣衛,卻被江湖人稱“盜聖一枝梅的沈鳶打亂。但沈鳶卻不幸受困,得到錦衣衛副指揮使周慕鋒的幫助脫險。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuch Liu plots to eliminate a rival imperial guard and seize a valuable treasure map. However, his plot is foiled by Thief Heroine, who is captured but later rescued by a deputy commander. The truth eventually reveals itself that it is all part of a conspiracy to unveil the secret of the Ming Dynastys hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亂世末期,商朝遭到周武王的進攻,被周軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻周,因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是,楊..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺,武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現,原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案,此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中,狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件,更有陰兵索命的傳言,案件一籌莫展..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Di Ren Jie is assigned by Empress Wu to investigate the massacre of Minister Hus family. In the process, he uncovers Hus involvement in a criminal case and encounters spooky incidents, as well as rumours of vengeful killing by hell guards. Di delves into the heart of the perplexing mystery, unravelling the truth behind it.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有妖怪殺手之稱的劉一刀為了給妹妹治病,不惜退隱江湖四處尋訪名醫。此時以蛇女和金蟾子為首的妖族,正密謀危害人間。後來劉陰差陽錯遇到錦鯉精小巒,得知她是黑龍轉世。妖族亦知道此事,也想爭奪小巒帶她去召喚..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon killer Liu Yi Dao retires from the martial arts world to find a doctor for his ailing sister. Meanwhile, the demon clan is plotting against the human world. Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著用生命來維護世間陰陽平衡的陽冥司端木熙,與遭遇車禍意外死去的漫畫屋老闆楊敬華。楊陰差陽錯被迫與端簽訂終身契約,成為端的影靈,二人互相看不慣對方,卻被契約緊緊捆綁在一起。之後連續發生詭異的死亡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a story about a ghost hunter, Duan, who is dedicated to maintaining the yin-yang balance and a comic store owner, Yang, who dies in a car accident. Yang becomes a spirit attached to Duan through a lifetime contract.  Initially at odds, they unite to entangle the mysteries of recurring bizzare deaths and restore peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀七十年代,香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重,黑惡勢力橫行,毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識,兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Drug lords Kun and Hao prosper amidst a corrupt landscape in the 1970s Hong Kong. ICAC officer Rose embarks on a mission to infiltrate Haos gang to gather evidence. However, as Rose and Hao fall in love, she faces a heart-wrenching dilemma — choosing between her duty to bring him down and the irresistible pull of their intensifying romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 率領神魔眾生征戰天道的上古戰神辰南,經歷沈睡萬年後從雪山之巔的墓群中蘇醒過來,但神力和記憶都被封閉。其後他在與守墓人的激鬥跌入斷崖後,無意間誤入楚國地界。最終辰南在解封自身神力及找回記憶的過程中,更一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ancient God of War Chen Nan, awakens after sleeping in the Snow Mountain for ten thousand years but has lost all his super power and memory. He falls from a cliff in a fight and accidentally enters the Chu State. As Chen Nan gradually restores his strength and memory,  he embarks on a journey to protect the world against evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.programme_title_tc: 封神榜: 決戰萬仙陣
epg.programme_title_en: The First Myth Clash of Gods
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.
