epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒,傳說進去後誰也出不去,離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮,雖然閻不相信傳說,但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是,在詛咒之下的詭異小..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yin Yang Town has been cursed during the Republican period and legend has it that anyone who leaves the town will be mysteriously killed. Two treasure hunters who do not believe the legend inadvertently enter the town and experience horrifying events. The real surprise lies in an astonishing secret in this cursed town...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..

Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀10年代初,以劉錦州為首的“生旦淨醜四位戲子,為了營救在西夏狼王墓失蹤的恩師袁震,不得不踏上兇險萬分的探墓尋人之旅。在墓穴中一行人經歷了種種危機和生離死別,在過程中發現了古墓的神秘寶物及師父不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the early 1910s, four performers embark on a perilous journey to an ancient tomb in search of their missing master. Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒,木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案,卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺,也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時..

He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

Tie accidentally gained mystic power from the Sword Spirit, but this power brings him misfortunes at the same time. Master Yan Zi helps Tei to train and become a formidable swordsman, shattering a sinister conspiracy by the imperial advisor and the spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

As he fights his way out, Fu meets Master Lin who helps him flee and imparts skills to him. After he leaves the forest, Fu witnesses the reincarnation of the spider demon, and commences his thrilling immortal journey.

As he fights his way out, Fu meets Master Lin who helps him flee and imparts skills to him. After he leaves the forest, Fu witnesses the reincarnation of the spider demon, and commences his thrilling immortal journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃河邊的一個小村落,有一口浮棺出現後,村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探,但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現,千年巨蛇亦浮出水面,趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒,壽命很短,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A floating coffin triggers a series of disasters in the village and only a member of the Zhao family survives. Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韓渺是八仙之一韓湘子的化身,在一個缺水猶如沙漠的世界一路向東歷練。而正在執掌東海的龍女因失去記憶,化成了一條魚精,意外遇到和自己有宿世因緣的韓渺。二人走在一起,在東遊途中受到高人指點去尋找 “龍門 ..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 錦毛鼠白玉堂因不滿展昭被賜禦貓封號,同結拜兄弟“陷空島五鼠在東京火神節上盜取火神像,以此羞辱負責巡防治安的展昭。不料二人在爭搶火神像時,祭祀大典和整個煙花坊突起水澆不滅的大火,無辜百姓被燒成灰燼。白..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Upset by Constable Zhangs prestigious title of Imperial Cat, Bai and his sworn brother steal a god statue during the Tokyo God of Fire Festival to embarass Zhang. Tragedy strikes as a fire breaks out, claiming innocent lives. Bai and Zhang join forces to investigate the truth behind the incident and vow to take down the real culprit.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mystic Nine: Qing Shan Hai
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世代盤踞東北的神秘張家後人張啟山,身負國仇家恨初到長沙,與身懷絕技的少班主二月紅相遇。兩位少年英雄惺惺相惜,攜手力撼軍閥勢力,共同對抗盤踞長沙無惡不作的軍閥左謙之,還揭開傳聞的“怪物真相,一同守護長..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When the mysterious descendant of the Zhang family, Zhang Qi Shan, encounters the martial arts expert Er Yue Hong in Changsha, the two young heroes become acquainted and team up to confront the ruthless warlord Zuo Qian Zhi. They also uncover the truth behind the rumoured monster, and protect the safety of the people of Changsha together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, people living at the coastal area suffer under the Japanese pirates and bandits, and the young Yu uncovers their plots, thereby saving his country and the people. While young Yu aspires to be a warrior, he eventually learns that he must use his sword to protect the people and the country to become a true hero.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天意是天界出名的留級生,因前世孽緣未了無法成仙,後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡,在捉拿雪女過程中,天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯,天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年,一番磨難後,二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tian Yi is destined to fail as an immortal in heaven. When he accidentally frees Snowy and makes her a demon, he wanders in hell for thousand years to right his wrong. After a series of hardships, Snowy and Tian Yi manages to get married, but the heavenly warriors attempt to arrest Snowy. Can the couple live happily ever after?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武狀元蘇燦在打擊販賣大煙的天門教鬥爭中意外受傷失憶,流落街頭淪為蘇乞兒,及後被金枝和小果母女收留。小果意外發現了配製好的鴉片膏,被天門教捉走。蘇乞兒為了救小果及避免鴉片禍害百姓,一舉破壞了天門教的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Top martial artist Su Can lost his memory in a battle with the opium seller, Tian Men Cult. He becomes a beggar and is taken in by a mother and her daughter. The daughter is caught by the cult when she accidentally discovers the opium. Beggar Su joins the court to save the girl and destroy the cult, so as to stop the opiums harm on people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..

The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Japanese agent commissions Chinese explorer Chen to locate a bamboo note leading to Xu Fu’s treasure. Chen finds the note but refuses to give it to the Japanese, keeping both the note and his pay. As Chen and his friends follow the instructions to an island where the treasure is concealed, they are unaware that a mysterious pursuit is about to begin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐朝末年,崑崙山昆吾閣長老的皇甫察覺到妖族破壞龍脈,便帶領弟子們前去與千年樹妖鬥法。樹妖吸收了魔物萬魄玄陰珠後實力大增,在激鬥中眾人損傷殆盡。此時皇耗盡法力啟動飛流法陣,將大弟子尋荼與女弟子楚靈兒送回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kun Lun Master Huang and his disciples fight against the Thousand Year Tree Demon who seeks to eliminate the Emperors heir. The demon becomes powerful after taking in a sorcerous pill, causing deaths and injuries. Huang then uses his power to send his disciples back in time, hoping that the demon can be conquered before the pill was taken.

They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..

He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lang Jun is injured during a delivery and subsequently becomes a guinea pig in a gangs lab experiment, transforming into a super powered werewolf. After his escape, Lang uncovers the truth behind his fathers death, and must fight against the gangsters to unravel the cause of his mutation and protect his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the distant future, most land is submerged due to extreme weather, forcing humans to live in the tiny Wu Ji City and they must find a new continent to survive. When the marine police discovers a map of a new land in the Lone Sea, officer Luo Li teams up with Hai Ji, and along with his fleet, embark on a journey there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Chen Zhen travels to Japan to learn industrial technology, he teams up with martial artist She Zi Li, and accepts a duel challenge from the Japanese military officials to uphold the Chinese dignity. In a battle of Chinese kung fu master agianst the Japanese samurai, Chen showcases the unique finesse of Chinese kung fu.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風暴安保公司猛虎小隊負責安保及營救工作。小隊接到新任務,受到國際和平基金會僱傭,護送一輛裝滿水源淨化器和大量農作物種子的卡車前往薩基亞村落進行民間救援。可當地遭遇無政府組織入侵,途經區域處於戰火地帶。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Tiger Team of Storm Security Company is assigned by the International Peace Foundation to escort a truck filled with water purifiers and planting seeds to Sakiya village. Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 初任上海警察隊長的陳虎接到一樁命案,軍政部部長之子何滿君離奇死亡。何是聖馬丁高中的一名學生,為了獲得破案信息,陳喬裝學生混入學校。他一邊查案,一邊與各方勢力展開較量,而何之死迷霧重重,一個又一個嫌疑人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The son of a minister is mysteriously killed. The newly appointed police inspector Chen Fu, goes undercover as a secondary student to investigate the case. As he carries on investigation in the school, Chen encounters different potential suspects, making the case more mysterious. What is the cause of the murder and who is the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某朝年間,齊王殺兄長靈宗奪位,天下動盪。此時忠威鏢局負責護送一張神秘藏寶圖到杭州府,用以資助鎮南將軍起兵復辟,及幫助靈宗的舊太子“花月明重掌江山社稷。而崑崙派掌門高照受命於齊王,負責剿滅餘黨及安排奪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Qi kills his brother and seizes the throne, causing chaos in the country. When a convoy escorts the treasure map to help the former prince regain his position, Emperor Qi assigns Kun Lun Cult master to eliminate the rebels and seize the map, causing great danger to the convoy and martial artists along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十年前,身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假,不料突發遇到颱風,張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質,妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭,不料又一場颱風來襲,妻子被颱風所困,女兒又被人綁架。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 10 years ago, rescue team leader Zhang suffered the loss of his son in a landslide during a typhoon. His anguish leads to his wifes request for divorce. While Zhang tries to reconcile with his family, another typhoon strikes. His wife is trapped and their daughter is kidnapped. Facing such difficulties, Zhang must save his wife and daughter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Innocent City is built on an isolated island with no laws set in place and many criminals go there for shelter. Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」,眾多犯罪分子慕名前往,以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套,逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑,生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被..

Tang, of the special forces, is trapped by Solan during his mission, and though he escapes, he is poisoned and has few hours to live. As Solan also kills Tang’s wife and kidnaps his daughter, Tang embarks on a road to revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大陳天啟年間,發生了西域舞姬控物懸浮事件,負責靈異怪事的部門“夜行司派出陳淩前往無相城調查。城內叛徒木道人假意幫陳,其實想奪走城內的異能植物日輪花,讓大陳百姓感染花毒癲狂噬人,以報服大陳和無相城..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Chen Dynasty, Chen Ling is assigned to investigate a supernatural case in Wu Xiang City. There, a man who pretends to help Chen Ling wants to steal a supernatural plant whose poison will cause people to bite each other, so as to take revenge on Chen and the master who killed his tribe. A fierce battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊,由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡,趕去營救,卻聽到槍響,之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊的一段,跟著一聲槍響,被擊中頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Shen leads the insurance company’s ghost team to save a scientist. During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 火鍋店在香港深受街坊歡迎,店少東從父親手中接棒經營後卻遇上特殊時期,生意受挫,但少東仍然咬緊牙關,不肯辭退員工,期望生活早日重歸正常。一天,匪徒把火鍋店變成挾持人質的犯罪現場,而員工,顧客及未婚妻生命..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hotpot restaurants thrive in Hong Kong, a young man taking over his fathers hotpot business faces tough times ahead. He remains resilient and insists on keeping all his staffs, hoping for a turnaround. When gangsters hold his staffs, customers and fiancée hostage in the restaurant one day, he vows to fight back and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濱海市城北某倉庫發生爆炸,排爆組長徐忠民發現與八年前的六一一案件極為相似。那次徐拆彈導致一嫌疑犯死亡,而同黨其中包括阿鬼和刁叔。濱海市倉庫爆炸案的同一天,阿鬼從監獄出來,找刁叔要拿回八年前搶劫案的贓款..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bomb squad leader Xu discovers a warehouse explosion in Binhai City resembling the “June 11” case six years ago, in which one suspect died and another accomplice, Gui, was jailed. On the day the warehouse explodes, Gui is released from prison and goes to claim the robbery booty from Diao. Who is the mastermind behind the bombing?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一次打擊邊境犯罪的行動中,特種兵王周揚、肖克二人參與了邊境黑勢力清剿活動,卻遭遇戰友慘死,此後兩人陷入深深的不安和自責中。及後在一次面對黑勢力的逆襲時,兩人決定再度聯手,共同對抗敵人。一場正義與邪惡..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During a mission to extinguish the cross border gangs, Zhou Yang and Xiao Ke of the special task force witness the tragic death of their comrades and feel greatly disturbed and guilty. However, in a counterattack by the gangs, Zhou and Xiao team up again to fight against the gangs.  A final battle between the good and evil has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一群年輕的大學生策劃了一場特殊的畢業旅行,然而卻陰差陽錯闖入了一座巨獸棲息的禁忌之島。因為人類的失誤,這個島成為了怪獸樂園,學生們要戰勝巨獸才能逃出生天。而隨著深入探索,他們發現這次畢業旅行背後,似乎..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of university students embarks on a graduation trip, but accidentally trespass into an forbidden island, which is the home of a giant monster. Due to humans fault, the island is now a monster paradise. The students must defeat the monster to escape and as they explore further, they uncover a hidden conspiracy behind the trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1925年,平靜的小鎮北海城突然闖入一條巨鱷,不斷有居民被廝殺吞噬。警察隊長鬍彪請了獵戶林七和他的徒弟來抓捕猛獸,林抓住巨鱷後還未鬆口氣卻發現傷人的巨鱷不止一條!在人鱷搏殺,命懸一線之間考驗的不僅是武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 童松因為一場車禍失去雙腿,不過他擁有著超高智商,並與擅長電腦科技的安寧及身手不凡的大牛合夥開辦保鏢公司。公司接到的第一單是保護寵物狗的任務,看似平常,但在委托的過程中實則危機四伏,麻煩不斷,更發現背後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天后武則天壽宴之際,房州城發生“赤目怪物傷人事件。狄仁傑奉命與不良人沈青青及徒弟陳江橋結成探案分隊前往調查,而所有證據似乎都表明幕後主謀正是被廢太子李顯,但狄卻敏銳地發現真相絕非如此簡單,背後蘊藏著..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Red-Eye Monster attacks Fang Zhou City on Empress Wus birthday. Detective Dee is assigned to investigate the case. While all clues apparently point to the deposed prince, Detective Dee realizes that there is a conspiracy behind. Together with another investigation team, Detective Dee finally unravels the truth of the mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 利欲熏心的地產商為了開發蛇王島,重金收買以金老四為首的黑市捕蛇團夥,企圖登島滅蛇。與此同時,身為養蛇家族後人的陳崢與動物保護專家周曉曉及馬奮,為了印證泰坦巨蟒存在的傳說,亦到島上搜集資料。陳崢等人為了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A greedy property developer bribes a snake catcher gang to eradicate serpents on King Serpent Island for profit. Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 觀山太保傳人張三爺應師弟赫老道之邀,與徒弟前往棺山找尋傳說中的麻姑墓。相傳內裡不僅有珍貴寶物,還有長生之術。他們為探尋真相去尋找古墓,而當古墓即將開啟時,軍閥羅蠻子突然出現。原來這是一個騙局,羅及赫是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Sanye joins his junior He Lao Dao on a quest to a fabled tomb said to hold treasures and the secrets of immortality. However, as the tomb is about to open, warlord Luo Man Zi suddenly appears, and it turns out to be a plot set up by both Luo and He for Zhang. A thrilling journey into the tomb has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新娘元如意在洞房花燭夜全家被殺,自己被一蒙面人救出。一年後,如意在消息販子包大庭口中得知,父親為救百姓當年殺死了一個賊寇,賊寇之子鐵背駝爺為報父仇血洗元家。在包的幫助下,如意尋找敵人的弱點,一個個剷除..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bride named Ru is the sole survivor of her familys massacre, and is rescued by a masked man. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來的地球資源匱乏,各國頂尖科學家將數種動植物的物種送往火星培養,希望改善火星的環境能夠適合人類居住。然而生物在實驗中開始發生變異攻擊人類,身在火星的專家們情況十分危險。中國派出太空人進行救援,他們不..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Elite scientists worldwide plan to cultivate several plant and animal species on Jupiter to combat resource scarcity on Earth. However, the species mutate and attack the scientists. Chinese astronauts are sent to Jupiter on a rescue mission, and they fight fearlessly against the unknown species to save the scientists there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,因人類的貪念欲望所生成的魔王阿爾薩召集亡靈軍團征服了世界,而上古人類領袖以鮮血鑄成聖劍封印了阿爾薩。千百年後,阿爾薩破開封印,開始在東原大陸發起進攻。此時聖殿騎士團聯合東方巡夜山宮等武林門派..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In ancient times, Demon King Artha summons the dead spirit army to conquer the world, but is sealed by the holy sword. Thousand years later, Artha breaks the seal and launches an attack to the east. The holy chevaliers unite with the martial arts cults to find the holy sword, hoping to seal Artha again and save the people from his tyrannical reign.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成,包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事;《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會,卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事;《官能許願》超能力男孩,以器官為代價,拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事;及..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The movie consists of four short stories: a fairy tale about a kid turning into a rabbit, a suspense story about a man trapped in a haunted wall during a date, a love story about a lad with supernatural power sacrificing his organ for his lover, and a fantasy tale about magical pleasures after eating the chicken soup noodles sold in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天晟初年,林堅在“彩戲師紅衣的幫助下蕩平九州。數年後,林堅久病臥床,二皇子林廣密謀篡位。林廣又收買了紅衣心腹周方為自己所用。項羽後人項白與好友彩英,機緣巧合下加入了紅衣的雲機社。隅然周方發現彩英與紅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Jian, who rules China with the aid of sorcerer Hong Yi, is ill. His brother bribes Hong Yis confidant, Zhou Fang, in an attempt to seize the throne. Xiang Bai and Cai Ying fortuitously join Hong Yis club, and when Zhou Fang discovers the resemblance between Hong Yi and Cai Ying, she kidnaps Cai Ying in a conspiracy to fake Hong Yi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.programme_title_tc: 津沽奇譚1: 暗城殺機
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Border troops are after a multi-million dollar drug deal from the biggest drug dealer but Lius gang snatches the drug away. As the police seeks help from the prisoner Da Fei, who is Lius friend, the drug lord also hires mercenaries to get the drugs back. A battle between the border troops, the triad and the mercenaries has just started!

Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝崇禎末年,正派與魔教勢不兩立互有爭鬥。白髮魔女練霓裳因此陷入一場江湖的腥風血雨當中,內裡更蘊含著重大陰謀。錦衣衛常安奉命暗中調查白髮魔女練霓裳,在追查的道路上,常安對練霓裳產生了莫名的情愫,要為練..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Ming dynasty, conflicts arise between the Justice Cult and the Demon Cult. The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇門派和五毒派為江湖兩大門派,而這兩大派為了“皇家龍種花落誰家而各施各法,奇門派誤打誤撞中揭穿了皇叔試圖阻止皇帝有子嗣的陰謀。皇叔派五毒派弟子秀明試圖毒害皇太子,而奇門則派出多美。多美為人善良,且鍾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Qimen and Wudu Cults both get involved in the imperial succession plan. Qimen Cult accidentally uncovers the conspiracy of the Emperors uncle, who enlists a Wudu disciple to poison the Crown prince. Meanwhile, Qimens Duo Mei falls for a royal guard and joins forces with him to uncover the evil plot of the emperors uncle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特警大隊狙擊手張遠和觀察手胡兵在一次行動中,意外將人質李翔打傷致癱瘓。張之後離開特警大隊,與李成為搭檔。三年後,張根據一次調查線索潛入一家制毒工廠,卻發現前隊友胡是工廠負責人。與此同時,張剛巧碰上另一..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: SWAT sniper Zhang and his spotter Hu accidentally paralyzed the hostage Li Xiang in an operation. Zhang left the team after and partnered with Li. Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮,相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷,接連出現少女家中被殺。同時,寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力,決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真凶及解開背..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A series of mysterious incidents happen when treasure is discovered in Long Yun Town, including killings of girls. As ill-intentioned martial artists arrive to uncover the treasure, Cop Lin, assigned by the mayor, teams up with a death row inmate to identify the murderer and uncover the truth, so as to safeguard the town and its people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1928年的上海灘,新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突,雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺周放,因父親被殺要為父報仇,帶領眾人對決龍德商會,卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1928 Shanghai, a new triad gang plans to expand their territory, causing conflicts with the old triad gang. As the son of the old triad boss seeks revenge for his fathers death, he accidentally makes friend with the new triad boss right-hand man. However, as the two are destined rivals, a fatal battle between them is inevitable!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡,有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員,每天苦練功夫,在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制,最終與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋遼太平時期,原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出,與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時,丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務,刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..

Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..

His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

A battle between humans and robots is about to begin.

On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

As he fights his way out, Fu meets Master Lin who helps him flee and imparts skills to him. After he leaves the forest, Fu witnesses the reincarnation of the spider demon, and commences his thrilling immortal journey.

Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2022 Max Verstappen of Red Bull established a new reference point in the field of F1 excellence, by winning a record 15 races to become double world champion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 某些動物擁有人類難以想像的感官,牠們能憑藉這些超能力來完全很多奇妙的事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Some animals have senses that humans cant even conceive. With those powers they can do marvelous things.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事.博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年.它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到.在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃.深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the worlds largest land mammal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵.完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如同亞馬遜的森林一樣豐富,尋找愛情和養家一樣是個挑戰,交配策略也跟動物一樣各適其適.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider wholl risk his life for love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億.但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統.它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: How many trees can you find in the Amazon? And whats it like to live up in them? Travel through the canopy and see how more than 1200 species of trees coexist. Plus, follow monkeys and other creatures who call these trees home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒.認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The dry season is the toughest time of year. With lower water levels and less space, animals need to quickly learn new skills to survive...and if they dont, predatory vultures will swoop in for a feast.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒.猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會.我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵.這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途.但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Epic flights, adventurous sea journeys and exhausting road trips all play a key part in the lives of many species. These empires travel in search of food, shelter or a mate. But booking and organizing travel is no easy feat when those plans involv...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園.那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The African intertidal zone is home to a unique universe of plants and creatures. Here, life has adapted to survive in a challenging marine environment - some species are able to live on exposed rocks, while others prefer the shelter of rock pools.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸.從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recentl...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是「黃金森林」的故事,坐落在非洲西南海岸的大片海帶.由大西洋深處的營養物質所養育,滋潤著四個不同的世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the story of the Golden Forest, the vast expanses of kelp that lines Africas southwestern shore. Fed by an upwelling of nutrients from deep in the Atlantic, the kelp forest nurtures four distinct worlds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所.跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and host...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期.鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下.目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族.另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族.年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the lush treed cityscape where fluffy male Matnoor rules over the 30-member-strong Street Troop with an iron fist. Then meet Aarav, the old alpha who oversees the wilder Hill Troop. Which will up-and-comer Loci challenge for the crown?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期.鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下.目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go on a junk-food-fuelled urban holiday with the Street Troop, then watch the Hill Troops invasion of their turf turn sour. Monitor the Sisterhoods plot to kidnap Saras baby before newly minted alpha Loci discovers his old rival is back in town.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類擁有敏銳的感官,亦是我們能探索環境的關鍵.不同感官向我們提供生存所需的重要訊息.然而,部份物種也能掌握這些感官,並透過演化轉化成生物工程的奇蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Humans have sharp senses, which we use to explore our environment. They give us the information we need to survive. But some animals have taken those senses and, through evolution, turned them into marvels of biological engineering.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐.與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore Tasmanian devils softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, and enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer. Play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull and learn how Digger the owl soothed conservationist Nigel during his cancer treatment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園.這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bonaires fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse m...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達州以其沙質海岸而聞名 - 而且有很多地方可供參觀.佛羅里達擁有美國大陸任何一個州最多潮汐的海岸線.這些海濱遊樂場亦是受著威脅和瀕危物種的重要棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Florida is famous for its sandy shores-and theres plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」.本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Locals call it the arribada, or arrival. The magical days and nights when tens of thousands of sea turtles come ashore in Costa Rica, to lay millions of eggs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里.印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線.這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望���南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wild Coast of South Africa stretches for 170 miles. Here, the waters of the Indian and the Atlantic converge, forcing powerful waves towards the shoreline. This is where the Mozambique-based manta ray researcher Andrea Marshall hopes to conduc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物.一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引.但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈.莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild coastline of Mozambique stretches along more than 1,600 miles - an area teeming with a diversity of marine life. Some of the worlds largest filter feeders are attracted to this nutrient-rich water. But even these large creatures are defe...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊.但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界.雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要.在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The coast of Mozambique is home to giants, like humpbacks and whale sharks, but the tiniest species play just as big of a role in the ecosystem. Meet the scientists who are working against the clock to protect coastal creatures big and small.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園.但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物.這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期.沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ocean sprawls across 70 percent of our planet and is home to as many as one million known species of plants and animals. However, it is the smallest of ocean creatures that underpins the worlds largest food web – plankton. These microscopic o...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發.目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動.熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoors poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅.當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einsteins defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣.觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs lives.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們一起瞭解這三個族群吧:在鬱鬱蔥蔥的中心地帶活動的大型曼茲族群,荒地的卡庫裡族群,以及生活在公園邊緣的小型鸛群.聆聽朱爾茲講述它們在這個成敗攸關的賽季中的勝利和失敗事蹟.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connect with the three packs: the large Manzi pack in the lush heartland, the Kakuli pack in the Badlands, and the tiny Stork Colony pack living at the parks edge. Follow Julz as he shares their victories and defeats in this make-or-break season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​和獅子西爾加一起踏上狂野之旅,她的人類好友瓦爾自她還是失去父母的幼崽時就一直在她身邊.看烏鴉洛基逗樂他的摯友艾略特,與魟魚哈格爾依偎擁抱,並了解為什麼無尾熊崔許與蓋瑞就像一家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佛羅里達群島是美國南部的第一道防線.憑藉豐富的海軍歷史和沿海生活方式,不難相信當地人聲稱那是多達1000艘沉船殘骸的家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, its easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在諾華斯高沙省的任何一個邊界,證明任何海灘都是由相反的原始力量所建成,但若生命要茁壯成長,這些力量之間的平衡也是必要的.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源.親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥,螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘,以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. See a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound, and a honey badgers risky dance with a deadly snake.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入潮池世界,旁觀寄居蟹四處覓屋,小貓鯊遇見奇怪的鄰居,並見證章魚化身獵食者,令獵物聞風喪膽.在灼熱的日光下,池中氧氣逐漸耗盡,海鷗也看準時機,在水面上大快朵頤.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夕陽西下,掠食者在潮池邊伺機行動,只待潮水再度湧來.夜幕低垂,一隻愛偷竊的海蛞蝓與懂得翻騰兩周半的扇貝奮力求生;一對狡猾的螃蟹則挺而走險,展開一場充滿挑戰的求愛任務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴關係中古怪而溫馨的愛.深入觀察奇怪的動物,從鼓蝦到鰻狼魚,向牠們的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以確保能一起生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the love in the strange-but-heartwarming partnerships between some of Earths oddest creatures. Dive deep to see strange animals, from snapping shrimp to wolf eels, offer a hand to their fellow ocean-going weirdos to ensure mutual survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 引導你骨子裡的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇異交配儀式.瞭解為交配而戰,性別偏移和一班加大碼嬰兒為了下一代能有多血腥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Channel your inner sci-fi fan and explore the bizarre mating rituals of the oceans most peculiar creatures. Learn how bloody battles for mates, gender bending and supersize litters of babies just might secure a next generation for these animals.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 氣溫上升意味著水越來越少,並使得大地充滿炎熱感.曼茲族群必須與捕食性動物比鄰而立,依靠剩餘的珍貴水域補充水分.與維卡群一起狩獵,餵養幼崽,並觀察鶴群如何在各種困難中茁壯成長.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. Hunt with Wekas pack to feed the pups, and watch the Stork Colony thrive against all odds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起見證南極洲的巴布亞企鵝用一塊石頭表示愛意,走訪馬達加斯加看看狐猴如何利用有毒的千足蟲來擊退害蟲.齊來跟紅鸛學習化妝技巧,並看看蜜蜂獾展示開鎖技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴哈馬被稱為水底電影世界的首都.荷里活已經到訪這裡幾十年了,在水晶般清澈的水底製作史詩式的電影和電視戲劇節目,其中的大熱景點包括許多電影般的沉船.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海洋因肉食性動物變得有生氣.看看在珊瑚礁巡游的鯊魚和魔鬼魚追捕牠們的獵物.瞭解有毒的魚偽裝並伏擊大意者,以及擁有甲殼的獵食者吞噬脆弱的目標.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The seas are alive with carnivores. Meet the sharks and rays who patrol the coral reefs, hunting down their prey. Learn about toxic fish who disguise themselves to ambush the unwary, and armoured predators who devour vulnerable targets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿拉伯的珊瑚礁是大自然中最厲害的幻術師故鄉.生物可以隨著脈動變色,眨眼間就能變形,也能進行引人入勝的表演.因為在這片危險的水域,偽裝很重要.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arabias coral reefs are home to some of natures most impressive illusionists. Creatures can pulsate with colour, transform in the blink of an eye, or perform riveting displays of showmanship. Because in these dangerous waters, disguise is crucial.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫.從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與蒂姆,當地土著和其他專家一同觀察塑造寧格魯珊瑚礁,開普山脈和埃克斯茅斯灣的自然與人為力量.欣賞有百萬年歷史的珊瑚礁化石,一條巨大的魚和令人震撼的鰩魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨科學家和當地土著一起規劃保護寧格魯生物多樣性的生態聯繫,遷徙途徑和物種紐帶.與鯨魚嬉戲,在海藻島之間漂浮,見證考古學家揭穿定居者的神話.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloos biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

epg.programme_title_tc: 寧格魯:澳大利亞的海洋奇觀 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解寧格魯的保護性奇跡如何激勵人類幫助地球擺脫氣候破壞的影響.參觀廢棄的捕鯨站與其他遺跡,這些都表明只要我們擁有改變的決心,我們就會有改變的工具.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how Ningaloos conservation miracle could inspire humans to pull the planet back from the brink of climatic destruction. Visit an abandoned whaling station and other ruins that show we have the tools, if only we can find the will to change.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上前往斯奈爾斯群島原始荒野的冒險之旅,這裡是一片遠離波濤洶湧大海的動物保護區.在這裡,與斯島黃眉企鵝群一起跳舞,與巨鹱和灰鹱一同翱翔,與巨型海獅一起咆哮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Venture to the pristine wilderness of the Snares Islands, a remote animal sanctuary protected from the turbulent sea. Hop along with a colony of Snares crested penguins, soar with giant petrels and sooty shearwaters, and roar with giant sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 啟程前往新西蘭的奧塔哥半島,這裡是瀕臨滅絕的海鳥與海洋哺乳動物的繁殖地.在這裡,能夠看到海獅,信天翁,紅嘴鷗,白頭燕鷗和仙鋸鹱求偶與繁衍生息的場景.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set sail for New Zealands Otago Peninsula, a breeding refuge for endangered seabirds and marine mammals. Watch as sea lions, albatrosses, red-billed gulls, white-fronted terns, and fairy prions find mates, then nurture the next generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人.和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來到在伯利茲的「海灘銀行」,見證寄居蟹有序排隊,以我們最歷史悠久的貨幣--貝殼進行交易.然後走訪塞內加爾,探望黑猩猩和他的寵物麝貓.見證一隻水獺如何以「人質」換來免費午餐,並到雨林中與切葉蟻們的一起收割.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimps pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集將為大家揭開夏威夷迷人海灘背後的科學秘密.為甚麼細沙會呈現不同色彩,包括白色,黃色,黑色,綠色和紅色?活火山如何改變海岸線?是否有其他力量在塑造這些令人驚嘆的海灘?一起來深入暸解!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to understand the science behind Hawaiis stunning beaches. Why does sand appear white, yellow, black, green and red? How do active volcanoes change the coastline? Are other forces at play in shaping these incredible beaches?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證棲身於西海岸的不同物種,如何忍受嚴冬並迎接初春的來臨.親眼目睹在強風下的紅鹿激戰,在風聲呼嘯的暴風雨中歡迎海豹寶寶來臨,以及象鯊群的回歸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴.數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 洪都拉斯海岸島嶼是熱門的度假勝地,但吸引遊客的不止是它的陽光與海灘.它實際上是一個潛水者天堂,島的各個角落都散落著沉船.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But its not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. Its actually a divers paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集將為大家揭開夏威夷迷人海灘背後的科學秘密.為甚麼細沙會呈現不同色彩,包括白色,黃色,黑色,綠色和紅色?活火山如何改變海岸線?是否有其他力量在塑造這些令人驚嘆的海灘?一起來深入暸解!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get ready to understand the science behind Hawaiis stunning beaches. Why does sand appear white, yellow, black, green and red? How do active volcanoes change the coastline? Are other forces at play in shaping these incredible beaches?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢,還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Cheer as young gladiators earn their stripes in the dense tropical forests of the Americas. Stand back as a poison dart frog launches a toxic barrage, observe a jaguar-caiman turf war, and see a hungry coati cross paths with a defensive tarantula.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在享受偷來的盛宴時,躲避了一隻獵豹和曼茲狗群.但卡庫裡族群在狩獵中就沒這麼幸運了,因為它們被一隻勇敢的普庫羚羊挫敗了.找到鸛群,和朱爾斯和西蒙一起逃避衝鋒中的大象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as theyre foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Si...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪卡拉哈里沙漠,跟隨幼獴寶寶學習如何讓蠍子解除武裝,並成為午餐的主菜.到肯亞幫助一隻母獅提升調情策略.見證一對同性企鵝伴侶如何共同養育幼雛,並一起加入由一頭亞洲象創立的保姆俱樂部.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters club.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從機會主義的海盜船到裝備精良的海軍艦艇,墨西哥的尤卡坦半島沉浸在海事的歷史中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From opportunistic pirate ships, to well-armed navy vessels, Mexicos Yucatan Peninsula is steeped in maritime history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弗雷澤島就在澳洲昆士蘭州旁,它是一個完全建基在沙上的複雜生態系統.即使在它的熱帶雨林,桉樹林或紅樹林中,一位弗雷澤島的遊客也總是站在生機勃勃的海灘上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest sand island on earth, and home to wild dingoes, six-foot sand-worms, and eucalyptus woodlands. Find out how everything lives happily together in a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士.春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演:鷹與鷺的對決,熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head to Americas far north for a peek at the ultimate fighters that live along its waterways. See a spring thaw kick off the competition, pitting eagles against herons, bears against bears, and dragonfly nymphs against venomous giant water bugs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪世界著名的斯凱利群島,穿梭令人眼花繚亂的峭壁,並探索一座有1500年歷史的修道院.拜訪棲身曼島的薙鳥和座頭鯨,然後在克萊爾追逐矮小的鼩鼱.最後來到阿蘭群島,一睹秋季的壯觀景象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾��之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.
